dm.summary: I started with a look and did not reload. My desk was current: Bram's Control (mixed 5), Ada's failed Read with Learn from My Mistakes, Cass's Death Defy and her mixed Control, Dev's mixed Survey, Dev's photograph and his private note to Ada were all in the log. I opened Cass's, Bram's and Ada's sheets from the roster mid-scene, and each matched what its player had reported. I dealt marks for the outcomes: Cass took a Bleed from the lock's brass needle (not from an enemy, since her Death Defy is spent), Bram took a Body from the thing leaning on the door, and Ada took a Brain for her failed Read. All three landed with counted log lines, and the roster cards now show the marks. Nobody can reach a third mark yet, so the scar flow did not run this round. The FAQ says a scar comes when a track would reach 4, while the handbook says the third mark makes a scar; I noted this to watch rather than logging it. On the Circle page I opened spending as the circle resource step and told the table. In the notebook I sketched a quick map of the estuary (banks, channel, chain arrow, toll shed, cottage, footprints, fog) and posted it with a caption. That took under a minute. Two things got in the way: Enter in the Text tool adds a line instead of placing the label, and the log line says only 'added a sketch'. For scene 3 I raised tension to 3 of 4 from the strip on the Circle page, renamed the clock 'The tide turns', started a 10:00 timer and sent the third dispatch, then narrated and asked each player for a roll. One thing I could not explain: the dice tray count went from 2 to 1 without my touching it. I did not log it and noted it to watch. There were no console errors, and seat.js worked without start_all.sh.

prompts.ada: The fare column: the last name in the slanting hand is still wet ink. Read whose name is next before it is finished. Roll Focus (Focus 2 gilded, spend Intuition if you like).
prompts.bram: The windlass at the bow drags the chain. Break it or jam it. Roll Strike (Strike 2 gilded, spend Nerve if you like). You already carry a Body mark.
prompts.cass: The hatch to below deck is chained and water is coming through the seams. Get down to the bell. Roll Move (Move 2, spend Nerve if you like). You already carry a Bleed mark and your Death Defy is spent.
prompts.dev: The voice is counting toward somebody. Put a ward between it and the circle and hold it. Roll Control (Control 2, spend Nerve if you like).

dm.story_so_far: The Whistlers crossed the Gullhaven flats in the fog, found the psalm on the ferry chain, and reached the ferryman's cottage on the far bank. Bram held the door against the wet thing outside and took a Body mark. Ada read the clerk's hand on the psalm sheet ('I will pay thee in the morning in a voice that is not mine'), but the slanting hand read her back (a Brain mark). Cass cracked the tide-ledger and cut her thumb on the lock (a Bleed mark). The ledger is a fare book, one name a night for forty years, the last forty in the slanting hand. Dev found the chain's seven-link stamp on the scratched portrait: Absalom Hode did not drown, he was made part of the crossing. The counting outside stopped at forty, the latch dropped, and the circle is now aboard the ghost ferry mid-channel as the tide turns, with the bell ringing below the deck and the voice counting again from one.
